blocks.text: This page tracks the Cloverdale MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $921,900 for a typical home, down 5.8% over twelve months.
Cloverdale benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical Cloverdale home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $921,900 in September 2026. That is down 1.0% on the month, down 2.5% over three months, down 4.5% over six months and down 5.8% over the year. Over three years it is down 11.7%, and over five years down 3.8%.
The weakest one-year move in Cloverdale was for an apartment homes at −8.9%; the strongest was a townhouse at −5.6%.
The gap between a detached home ($1,317,200) and an apartment ($506,700) is $810,500, and a townhouse ($754,300) sits $247,600 above the apartment benchmark.
Against the Fraser Valley Board area, where the all-home benchmark was $861,300, Cloverdale is 7.0% above. Over the year the Fraser Valley Board area moved down 7.2% against down 5.8% here.
Of the 8 areas this board reports, Cloverdale ranks 4 by all-home benchmark, with Langley above it at $941,800 and Surrey below it at $906,200.

Detached homes in Cloverdale: benchmark $1,317,200, down 1.7% in a month, down 2.7% in three months, down 5.3% in six months, down 6.9% in a year, down 11.3% in three years and down 5.1% in five. That is 1.3% above the detached benchmark for the Fraser Valley Board area ($1,300,000).

Townhouse homes in Cloverdale: benchmark $754,300, down 0.4% in a month, down 1.8% in three months, down 3.1% in six months, down 5.6% in a year, down 11.0% in three years and up 1.0% in five. That is 1.2% above the townhouse benchmark for the Fraser Valley Board area ($745,300).

Apartment homes in Cloverdale: benchmark $506,700, up 0.2% in a month, down 2.3% in three months, down 7.7% in six months, down 8.9% in a year, down 11.9% in three years and down 0.3% in five. That is 9.7% above the apartment benchmark for the Fraser Valley Board area ($461,800).

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in Cloverdale?
faq.a: In September 2026, a typical Cloverdale home was $921,900, with detached at $1,317,200.

faq.q: Are Cloverdale home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: Cloverdale is down 5.8% over twelve months and down 2.5% over three months.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
